title: agents_schema.yml
description: Project config for dbt-agents-schema (spec v1, section 3).

version.description: Config format version. Only 1 is valid.

project.description: Key that owns this project's rows. Pattern ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$. Must be unique within an agents schema.

owner.description: Free text, for example a team email. Published to DBT_PROJECT.

description.description: Free text. Published to DBT_PROJECT and the project/<project> ROOT row.

include_packages.description: Also publish models from installed dbt packages.

exclude_packages.description: Package names never published, even when include_packages is true.

skills_dir.description: Directory of markdown skill files, relative to the project. A missing directory means no skills.

environments.x-default: prod (credentials: env, schema: AGENTS) and dev (credentials: dbt_profile, schema: "{{ target_schema }}_AGENTS")

check.description: Settings for `dbt-agents-schema check` (also run by publish).

description_scope.description: Models the description rules apply to: public = models with access: public; all = every published model.

external_schemas.description: Schemas skills may reference in uses that dbt does not build.

missing_model_description.description: A model in description_scope has an empty description.

missing_column_description.description: A column of a model in description_scope has an empty description.

sampled_values_in_description.description: A description looks like data profiling output (min/max, null rates, sample values, row counts).

skill_without_uses.description: A skill file has no uses frontmatter.

skill_unresolved_uses.description: A uses.schemas or uses.tables entry matches no published model and is not in external_schemas.

credentials.description: env = WAREHOUSE_CREDENTIALS from the environment (CI); dbt_profile = the project's dbt profile (developers).

database.description: Snowflake database, BigQuery project, Databricks catalog or DuckDB catalog. Template allowed.

schema.description: Agents schema (BigQuery dataset). Template allowed: {{ target_schema }}, {{ target_database }} (dbt_profile only), {{ project }}, {{ env }}.
